create_report_from_batch: create a Report from a SampleList batch and model output dictionary
apply_fn_to_report_fields: apply a callable function to all or specific fields in a Report
detach_report_tensors: detach all tensor items in a Report from their computation graphs
move_report_to_device: move a Report to a specific torch device like cuda or cpu
accumulate_report_tensor_fields: accumulate tensor fields and losses from one Report into another
